activity_summary: You went on without stopping to the castle wall at Flint and a king coming down. You stayed in the chair. The leaf ends while he is still coming down. The second candle guttered while you were still seated.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the coming down, and ended the leaf there.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in A king coming down
